title: A Differential Evolution Algorithm with Principal-Axis Manifold Projection and Configuration-Entropy Double-Locking and Its Application to Mechanical Design Optimization
status: Original supplied PADE MATLAB files and extracted original result tables are preserved. These supplied demo scripts do not by themselves reproduce every reported 23-function/30-run result. PADE-FE v4 is a separate implementation and is published in a separate branch.
entry: The three original .m files are the available implementation. Inspect their actual settings before running. Tables under 论文修订_20261015/analysis are preserved original-paper records, not regenerated experimental results.
